anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Unless you eat my flesh and drink my blood.
You have no share with me — the papyrus joins this to John 6:53.

choices.why: The papyrus has the John 13:8 close; keep it.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] and the having been completed in deed, they having received it lawfully, who in haste of faith and a tightening of bodily thoughts and a ready shoeing toward preparation of a good-working journey, staffs being handled in hands for them, live in fear the living from this, which becomes salvation for them, and unless you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you have no share with me.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] and that it has been completed in deed, they having received it lawfully, who in haste of faith and a tightening of bodily thoughts and a ready shoeing toward preparation of a good-working journey, staffs being handled in their hands, live in fear the life from this, which becomes salvation for them — and "unless you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you have no share with me."
source_text: <* * *> τὸ δε ἔργῳ ἐκτ[ετε]λέσθαι ἐννόμως αὐτὸ εἰλ[ηφό]τας, οἵτινες ἐν σπουδῇ πίσ[τεω]ς καὶ σφίγξει ἐννοιῶν σωμ[ατι]κῶν καὶ ὑποδέσει ἑτοίμῃ πρὸς παρασκευὴν ὁδοιπορίας ἀγαθοέργου, βακτηριῶν αὐτοῖς ἐν χερσὶν μεταχειριζομένων, ἐν φόβῳ τὴν ἐκ τούτου βίωσιν <διάγουσιν>, ἥτις αὐτοῖς σωτηρία γίνεται, καὶ "ἐὰν μὴ φάγητέ μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίητέ μου τὸ αἷμα, οὐκ ἔχετε μερίδα μετ’ ἐμοῦ".
